To:  City Clerk
Subject:  Paige - Affelbaugh camps

Hi Council members,

  I am a 10 year North La Verne Resident with three kids in our district. I recently heard about these
camps being converted to Juvenile Detention camps for hardened criminals, so called youths ranging in age
from 16- 25... basically adults. I am very disappointed that I was NOT informed by my city about this as my
home is closest to the camps. I would have expected to see a mailer go out to all nearby residents informing us
of what is coming and how we can voice our opinion against this transformation. I appreciate that our city
leaders are against this from happening but I feel we need to do more. For example, Show up and lead rallies
opposing this camp, Send information to residents affected by these camps and show a united front with our
school  district, residents,  and  city and get our city attorney involved!!! I have read the literature on how they
want to operate these camps and it is scary.

  My two younger kids ( ages 12), ride their bikes around Marshall Canyon and Stevens Ranch Road. My
older daughter is a student at BHS and is on the golf team which practices at Marshall Canyon Golf
Course... directly  on Stevens Ranch Road which is the only access point to and from the camp. My daughter
and her friends walk the course and walk home on Stevens Ranch Road. I am not comfortable with hardened
criminals  unarmed facility less than a mile from the golf course. I am not OK with
  living in an unsecured -
visitors to the camp traveling up Stevens Ranch Road to visit the residents there either. Also, what is the plan
after these  so  called  youths  are released  from the camp? The JJD material  states that they want to have the
nearby cities employ and help rehab these criminals by allowing them to work in the communities. I hope that
our city is vehemently opposed to this and is fighting hard to prevent this from happening. Thank you for your
time.

Sincerely

Glenn Diekmann and Niki diekmann
